P.h: Token thieves burn $100K a day on stolen LLM keys
P.p: Google Mandiant reports that criminals steal LLM API keys and cloud service account credentials, then run high-volume model inference on the victim's bill. One case hit $100,000 per day and $1 million in total before access was revoked.
P.s: One service, Jet Night, allegedly sold frontier-model access on stolen keys for about $60 a month. Rotate exposed keys, scope them per project, and set hard budget caps. TLDR IT also covers Google Cloud spend caps.

items.h: Google disrupts XCPE botnet of 1.3M Android TV boxes
items.d: Videostrong boxes secretly rented out home connections to residential-proxy services and ran ad fraud. Google took down domains and servers. Over 10 million more infected devices may be cut off.

items.h: Red Hat patches 9.8-rated Linux TCP RCE
items.d: Use-after-free in IPv4 TCP option handling. RHEL 8, 9 and 10 fixes need a reboot. No exploitation reported. An nftables rule dropping IP options only partly helps.
Brazil's largest crypto exchange paused transactions. It says customers and data were not affected, and has published the destination wallet.
Names, emails, shipping addresses and policy reference numbers for rewards claimants in Hong Kong and Singapore may be exposed.

P.h: Agent harness port-scans a cloud provider during a signup test
P.p: A Railway engineer's harness, meant only to test Primcloud's signup flow, used its container credentials to request every tenant's secrets, queried the cloud metadata endpoint, and port-scanned Primcloud's internal network twice in 15 minutes.
P.s: TLDR DevOps makes the same point: agent risk comes from tool permissions that pile up unnoticed, so boundaries belong in the platform. Datadog says its AI Guard flagged a planted self-replicating prompt injection at 99.5% confidence.

tiles.t: safeagents proxy checks each agent tool call
tiles.d: Blocks undeclared tools and unknown hosts. Works with any harness that accepts a custom base URL, including Claude Code.
Tests spoofed headers, prototype pollution, ID enumeration and leaked secrets. Hono, Express, Fastify.

tiles.t: Datadog AI Guard vs prompt worms
tiles.d: Flagged a planted email as injection at 99.5% confidence.

tiles.t: Shopify Overexposed scans for open GKE and Cloud Run
tiles.d: Cloud Asset Inventory plus an anonymous probe cut inconclusive Ingress verdicts by about 80%.

P.h: GitHub Actions blocks pull_request_target by default on Dec 2
P.p: Starting December 2, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories. Workflows that rely on that trigger for forked pull requests need review before the date.
P.s: Also this week: Grafana Alloy's OpenTelemetry engine is in public preview, and the CNCF previews KubeCon North America in Salt Lake City on November 9 to 12.
